CapacityPack.description: Board 3.8. **A good season should not require renegotiating a contract in August.**

licensedModules.description:
**A closed set as of 24 August.** `moduleKey` was a free string, so nothing could join a licence to a screen — **a tenant without an F&B licence was still served every F&B screen**, because no screen said which module it belonged to in a form the licence could match.
**The key is the join.** `screen.requiresModule` names one of these, and navigation is built from the intersection of what a tenant licensed and what their role permits.

includesBrandedApp.description: Branded native publishing carries per-tenant operational cost and is priced, not absorbed.

includedAiTokens.description: AI tokens the package includes per billing period. Usage beyond it is a `metered` invoice line at the AI module's price (decided 29 September).

packageKind.description: **Three standard packages, and custom ones allowed** (decided 29 September, Chinmay).

offeredToTenantId.description: **Private to one tenant** (decided 29 September, Chinmay): a custom package offered only to this tenant; `listPlans` shows it to no other tenant and `setSubscription` refuses it for any other (422 `plan-not-offered`). Null for a package any tenant may buy. Custom packages only.

ModuleListing.description:
Board 4.6. **A marketplace without a dependency graph sells combinations that cannot be provisioned.**
**TICVAI configures each module's price here, and tenants are billed per module (decided 29 September, Chinmay).** A usage-priced module (the AI module's tokens) has `pricingBasis` `metered`: `price` is then per `meteredUnitSize` units of `meteredMetric`, and the invoice carries it as a `metered` line.

moduleCode.description:
**Values are `ModuleKey`s** (4 October 2026, CHG-FXC-010; ADM-424): the vocabulary of
`white-label.ModuleEnablement.moduleKey`, so a dependency is checked against what `setModuleEnablement` switches.

requiresModules.description:
**Values are `ModuleKey`s** (4 October 2026, CHG-FXC-010; ADM-424): the vocabulary of
`white-label.ModuleEnablement.moduleKey`, so a dependency is checked against what `setModuleEnablement` switches.

incompatibleWithModules.description:
**Values are `ModuleKey`s** (4 October 2026, CHG-FXC-010; ADM-424): the vocabulary of
`white-label.ModuleEnablement.moduleKey`, so a dependency is checked against what `setModuleEnablement` switches.

meteredMetric.description: For `metered`, what is counted (`aiTokens` for the AI module). Null otherwise.

meteredUnitSize.description: For `metered`, how many units `price` buys (e.g. 1000 tokens). Null otherwise.

PackageSimulation.description: Boards 3.9 and 4.8. **Refused at quote time rather than at go-live.**

Plan.description: **A plan's modules and limits are rows, keyed on `plan_id`.** `licensedModules` and `limits` are required on every plan, and `subscription.plan` alone had no column for either — so the licence position, the downgrade check and every module gate had nothing to read. `plan_module` holds one row per licensed `ModuleKey`; `plan_limit` one row per `EntitlementLimit`. Both belong to the plan version the row is, so a subscriber on an earlier version keeps the modules and limits they were sold.

version.description: Existing subscribers stay on the version they were sold. A price change never applies retroactively.
